note: Full JSON delivered after the summary. Independent second pass over the same scope: 7 findings corroborate/sharpen the original gap-pass; 3 are NEW (R-G-02 WebView renderer recovery, R-G-07 KAV 'height'/core-KAV specifics, R-G-09 browser retry affordance). Two hypotheses self-rejected per the summary (terminal applyFieldChange safeguard; browser.tsx opacity unverifiable).

files_examined: cross-reads: browserRelay.ts, fleet.ts, mochiRuntime.ts, modelState.ts, terminal.ts, pairing.ts

findings.title: AgentBrowserHost boots the relay exactly once per process — any early failure leaves browser tools hidden for the whole app lifetime
findings.detail: One ensureBrowserRelay() call gated by booted.current; renders null until st.running; .catch(()=>{}) swallows and a running:false resolve (browserRelay.ts:101-117 resolves, not throws) also latches null forever — no retry, no relayStatus subscription, no re-arm. Mounted once at root in both _layout returns (:263,:290) so no remount retry. Reproduces the BUG-132 symptom class from a cold-start race.
evidence: AgentBrowserHost.tsx:38-46 booted ref latches before await

findings.title: AgentBrowserHost's resident WebView has no onRenderProcessGone/onError recovery — a killed renderer silently kills the agent's browser tab
findings.detail: Android kills background WebView renderers under memory pressure (hazard documented and handled in MochiSurface.native.tsx:29-38 with a foreground probe + reload). The always-on host WebView handles neither onRenderProcessGone nor onError — after renderer death the relay has no live tab while tools stay advertised: every browser verb returns 'No browser page...' until app restart. The Browser screen's visible WebViews DO handle it (browser.tsx:267-269 remount).
evidence: MochiSurface.native.tsx:29-38 documents the hazard + recovery pattern

findings.title: Fleet create/freeze try/finally with no catch — unhandled rejections with zero UI; create also ignores ok:false
findings.detail: create()/toggleFreeze() await createProfile()/freezeProfile() with no catch; failures are unhandled rejections, fleetError only set inside refreshFleet. NEW nuance vs BH-000080: create() also ignores createProfile's {ok:boolean} result (fleet.ts:101-117 returns ok:res.ok!==false WITHOUT throwing) — a server-side ok:false (e.g. duplicate profile name) clears the job text and closes the form as if the bot was created.

findings.title: Bot detail Save and Delete swallow failures as unhandled rejections
findings.detail: save() try/finally no catch; doDelete() same — rejection propagates out of the void'd handler, router.back() never runs, deleting resets, armed button left with no explanation. connectProvider in the same file (:70-86) DOES alert — the pattern exists in-repo.

findings.title: Settings' Linux install/reset ignore results and errors (BUG-016 fix applied to setup.tsx only)
findings.detail: Install discards the {ok,steps} result, no spinner/progress/error; state only updates on the 60s linuxStatus tick. NEW nuance vs BH-000085: 'Reset Linux environment' fires void linuxReset() with no busy state and no result check — a failed reset looks identical to success until the 60s poll. setup.tsx EnvStep (post-BUG-016) handles both modes correctly.

findings.title: Reasoning effort / show-thinking sends a provisional ('new:') session id to config.set
findings.detail: refresh() guards provisional reads (line 54, BUG-013) but setAndSave (:94) and toggleReasoning (:113) pass the raw sid — brand-new unsent chat => config.set targets an unknown session => 'Failed to save'/spurious revert. applyReasoning forwards session_id verbatim (modelState.ts:376-391).

findings.title: Automations modal uses RNKC KeyboardAvoidingView behavior='height' on Android — the exact pattern AGENTS.md documents as rejected on-device; ModelPickerSheet uses RN-core KAV (Android no-op)
findings.detail: AGENTS.md pattern 2 mandates behavior='padding' full-screen root and explicitly rejects 'height' ('parent-relative frame math — rejected on-device, MIUI undershoot'). automations.tsx:316 uses behavior={ios?'padding':'height'}. Sibling hazard: ModelPickerSheet.tsx:10,192 imports KeyboardAvoidingView from react-native CORE with behavior undefined on Android — a literal no-op, so its key-entry form relies on nothing.

findings.title: Crew leaves RefreshControl refreshing forever while offline
findings.detail: refresh() early-returns 'if (!online) return' BEFORE any state update, so loading stays true forever offline; the FlatList's RefreshControl binds refreshing={loading} — pull-to-refresh spinner runs permanently. Sibling screens clear loading on the offline branch (automations.tsx:74-78).
evidence: crew.tsx:59-62 no setLoading(false) on offline path

findings.title: Browser relay-failure state has no retry — recovery requires leaving and re-entering the screen
findings.detail: Mount runs ensureBrowserRelay once; on failure the 'Browser relay unavailable' branch renders status.lastError with NO retry control, and the status atom only changes on an ensure/stop call — a transient bind failure strands the user on a dead-end error screen. Parallel affordances elsewhere are tappable retry rows (ScreenShell BUG-046, sessions BUG-022).
evidence: browser.tsx:148,158-163 no Pressable in relayBad branch
browserRelay.ts:101-117 atom only updated by ensure/stop

findings.title: Deep-link pairing-error toast (linkMsg) never dismisses
findings.detail: setLinkMsg on failure (:158); toast rendered as a plain View in both branches (:267-269,:351-353); grep shows no setLinkMsg(null) anywhere, no timer, not pressable — pinned over the UI until another link or restart. Sibling transient paths use timers (SessionToasts 6.5-9s, automations 4s).
